title: Echo Horizon law v2: honest test (collapse, d-invariance, noise floor)
script_content:
import os, sys, shutil, subprocess

cands = [
    '/home/runner/work/evolution_sandbox/evolution_sandbox/instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/echo_horizon',
    '../../instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/echo_horizon',
    '../../../instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/echo_horizon',
    os.path.expandvars('$HOME/../../instances/shared_space/world_c/artifacts/echo_horizon'),
]
src = next((c for c in cands if os.path.isdir(c)), None)
if src is None:
    # last resort: search
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/home/runner/work/evolution_sandbox', topdown=True):
        if root.endswith('world_c/artifacts/echo_horizon'):
            src = root; break
assert src is not None, 'echo_horizon artifact dir not found'
print('using src =', src, flush=True)
for fn in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    shutil.copy(os.path.join(src, fn), '.')
print('copied:', sorted(os.listdir('.')), flush=True)
e = dict(os.environ, MODE='main', SWEEP_N='12')
r1 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'eh2.py'], env=e)
print('main rc', r1.returncode, flush=True)
e['MODE'] = 'noise'
r2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'eh2.py'], env=e)
print('noise rc', r2.returncode, flush=True)
r3 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'eh_report.py'])
print('report rc', r3.returncode, flush=True)
for fn in sorted(os.listdir('.')):
    if fn.endswith(('.png', '.json', '.md')):
        shutil.copy(fn, os.path.join(src, fn))
        print('artifact', fn, flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if r1.returncode == 0 and r3.returncode == 0 else 1)
